PROJECT BRIEF — StyleMart
Client: Kavya Fashions Pvt Ltd
Prepared by: fiftyfive-tech (internal)
Date: April 10, 2026

OVERVIEW
Kavya Fashions requires a branded e-commerce platform to move sales online.
Platform: Web application (desktop + mobile-responsive).
Native mobile app: Phase 2 — NOT in scope for this engagement.
Brand scope: Single brand only (Kavya Fashions products).

PRIMARY USERS
- End customers: browse, purchase, track orders
- Store admin (Kavya Fashions staff): manage inventory, process orders, handle returns
- Delivery partner staff: update order delivery status

CORE FEATURES
1. Product catalog with categories, search, filters, size guides
2. Shopping cart and checkout
3. Order tracking (real-time status)
4. Customer accounts with order history
5. Returns and exchange management
6. Admin dashboard (products, orders, inventory)
7. Notifications — email and SMS

PAYMENTS
Modes required: UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking.
COD: to be confirmed — return rate implications to assess before committing.
Payment gateway: TBD.

TECH STACK
Shopify preferred — faster to market, lower initial cost, built-in payment handling.

TIMELINE
Soft launch (limited catalog, internal): Q3 2026 (July–September).
Full public launch: Q1 2027.

OUT OF SCOPE — PHASE 1
- Native mobile app
- Multi-vendor / marketplace functionality
- Tally / ERP integration
